trainers.instruction: Which thermometer shows a higher temperature? Choose the correct comparison symbol.

wrong.text: The temperature shown by the <t-purple>purple thermometer</t-purple> is less than the <t-yellow>orange thermometer</t-yellow>.

hint.text: The point of the comparison symbol should face the lower temperature. When both thermometers show the same temperature, the equals sign (=) is used.
hint.sound: The point of the comparison symbol should face the lower temperature. When both thermometers show the same temperature, the equals sign is used.
